# Billing Assumptions Note 4

We assume that billing handling of receipt interacts with settlement; teams noted that arrears depends on dunning and payout, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that billing handling of ledger interacts with chargeback; teams noted that invoiceline depends on creditnote and discount, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: billing handling of writeoff interacts with gateway; teams noted that surcharge depends on refund and currency, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that billing handling of proration interacts with renewal; teams noted that invoice depends on subscription and payment, especially under real production load.
